maya: Quick kickoff for Needlepoint benchmark launch — keep it focused: 3 visuals, 2 CTAs, 1 live interactive demo.
james: Proposed visuals: cost heatmap (QPS vs seq len -> $/1k), tail latency (p50/p95/p99), throughput-per-dollar by deployment.
manila: Webinar interactive: batch-size slider + prefix-cache toggle so attendees see cost delta live. Good for eng audience. :thinking_face:
anita: Copy angle: developer-first, avoid absolute multipliers. Headline idea: 'Trade latency for cost with predictable levers.'
toni: Routing: Landing CTAs 'Request demo' -> Enterprise SDRs; 'Try benchmark' -> Growth sandbox. Use utm_campaign=needlepoint_launch.
benchbot: bench snapshot: model=redwood-v1-small qps=50 batch=8 mean=48ms p95=210ms cost_per_1k=0.27
james: Use bench snapshot in appendix and as an example callout on the landing.
manila: Segmentation: SMB = cost/convo; Enterprise = SLA/fallbacks + rollouts. Mark demo watchers as high-intent for SDR routing experiment.
maya: Deliverables: @anita landing + social, @james charts + interactive, @toni webinar script + slides. I'll compile the public one-pager once drafts are in.
